title: traffic apart, two players, NO merger: the host decides per peer which traffic that client runs - beyond 350 m from everyone the client runs its OWN Gley traffic, within 250 m of anyone the host's ghosts rule. The lever is forced through both flips so the fixture's geography cannot decide the test: local (own cars, no ghosts), then back to ghost (ghosts, no own cars), then released to the distance rule with the client teleported onto the host, which must settle in ghost mode. Both handovers must FADE, and the two 20 s ceiling lines are now REPORTED rather than failures: a car stopped in full view (queued, at a red light) never goes off-screen, so the 70 m retire rule is the cover and the ceiling is only the residual - the manager reads the count; ends without leaving; NO save
preconditions: Fixture save1 (the host melaus, Client1). Build TRAFFIC-APART deployed (dev build: the traffic / trafficmode / tp levers are BAMP_DEV only). The rig runs both instances on ONE machine over the LAN link. The two avatars spawn at their own saved positions, so the INITIAL verdict depends on how far apart the fixture puts them - step 7 records it and accepts either. FIXTURE HYGIENE: NOTHING is saved.
